paragraphs.text: Lord Kazmyr is a winged thrull , and the pet of kingpin Ilona . He is not a lord over anything, but having her thrull bear a noble name is a source of amusement for Ilona.

When the playwright Symond Halm asked to produce a dramatic theatre play with Ilona's money, he had to sign a contract that put his life on the line should he fail. Lord Kazmyr was present at the signing, and when he let Symond out the door as he was leaving, he told the playwright: " Bilagru will come for you."

Lord Kazmyr was with Ilona when Symond Halm's play was launched. The gold had been spent on lavish costumes and set designs, but only a quarter of the seats were filled. Fearing for his life, Symond bolted, but Lord Kazmyr fluttered up to the outcrop of some masonry, and told Symond Halm "Bilagru is coming for you." When Symond Halm only gaped at the thrull, Lord Kazmyr repeated, "Bilagru is coming for you, debtor."

In desperation, Symond killed a vedalken man to be put into an Azorius prison, supposedly hidden away from Bilagru. But later, Lord Kazmyr found the window of the playwright's cell. As Symond peered out the window, trying to understand what he saw in the darkness, Lord Kazmyr intoned again - "Bilagru will come for you."

Then Bilagru went to work. Guards were yelling out orders and the bright blue crackle of Azorius spells flashed, illuminating a panicked scene for only moments at a time. Guards rushed passed Symond's cell, and the other prisoners added their shouts to the clamor. There were shrieks, and Lord Kazmyr fluttered outside Symond's cell, droning the unrelenting, unforgiving, "Bilagru will come for you."
